dogecoin.text:
Too many people going to read this as DOGE. It's not. It's DOGECOIN CASH.

Separate.
"Designed to operate within the decentralized finance ecosystem, Dogecoin Cash exists on both the Ethereum blockchain as an ERC-20 token, and on Binance Smart Chain in the BEP-20 format."

"Under the Proof of Content system, content creators can earn Dogecoin Cash by sharing links on the social platform Tipestry, members vote to determine how much crypto each post and comment receives."

What in the fuck is this DOGECOIN Cash.

"Instead of the carbon-emitting POW mining used by coins like Bitcoin and Dogecoin, Dogecoin Cash uses the innovative new Proof of Content mechanism to distribute DOG to the community."
